demo.step1.title: The command
demo.step1.body: /btc:fees asks for the current fee rates, with a word limit for the answer.
demo.step2.title: The tool call
demo.step2.body: bitcode reads the network in read-only mode: mainnet, five fee tiers in sat/vB.
demo.step3.title: The answer
demo.step3.body: The model sums up the result in one sentence. Recorded on 2026-09-11: these are not live fees.
hero.appAlt: bitcode Desktop in the dark theme: a chat with the agent and an approval card waiting for a yes.
hero.sat.node: I read the chain. I never send funds.
hero.sat.script: I write the code. Every change waits for your yes.
hero.sat.hash: I check the amount and the network before anything is signed.
hero.sat.merkle: I plan the work. You keep the last word.
demo.title: Ask. Read the card. Say yes.
demo.lead: The same agent in the desktop app and in the terminal. Anything that changes files, runs commands or moves funds waits for you.
demo.desktop.title: An RGB payment, from invoice to your yes.
demo.desktop.caption: Recorded in bitcode Desktop on an RGB test network with a local QVAC model. Pointer added; waits shortened where the badge shows it.
demo.desktop.step1.title: The request
demo.desktop.step1.body: In an RGB session on a test node, paste an invoice and say how much to send.
demo.desktop.step2.title: The card
demo.desktop.step2.body: Before anything is signed, a card spells out amount, asset, recipient, network and node.
demo.desktop.step3.title: Your yes
demo.desktop.step3.body: Approve once and the node sends on the test network. The RGB tab shows the transfer in flight.
desk.first-run.title: Open it. Pick a local model.
desk.first-run.body: Start the app, choose one of the models Ollama already serves on your computer, with its memory needs in view, and open a project. The first answer comes from that local model.
desk.configuration.title: Your models, your limits.
desk.configuration.body: Give each Sat its own model, keep everything local, see where cloud keys would go and decide whether a phone may reach the app. Each chat then picks Manual, Assisted or Unattended.
desk.features.title: Every change waits for you.
desk.features.body: In Manual mode the agent reads the project inside its sandbox, proposes the fix as a diff and asks before running a command. Approve each step, then read the Changes panel.
desk.rgb.title: Send an RGB asset. Confirm it yourself.
desk.rgb.body: An RGB session on a test node: the agent reads the balances, the receiving node issues an invoice in the app’s terminal, and a payment card waits for your approval before the node sends.
